title: Targeted CTest should build or validate selected VIXEN executables
body: The queued focused command ctest --test-dir build/wsl -R Application.UpscalerSelection --output-on-failure reported Not Run because test_upscaler_selection was not built; a separate queued cmake --build build/wsl --target test_upscaler_selection was required. The VIXEN test registration should expose an affected-target build helper or make the focused witness prerequisite explicit.

title: Native launcher should provide a Windows-accessible Yeroket root
body: The queued native configure forwarded YEROKET_ROOT=/home/liory/Github/Yeroket-Fantasy as the UNC path //wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/liory/Github/Yeroket-Fantasy, and Windows CMake rejected it before snapshotting. Recovery required cloning the pinned kernel object database into the native checkout at /mnt/c/vixen-native/vixscale1/.tmp/yeroket and rerunning with YEROKET_ROOT there. The native launcher should resolve or provision a Windows-accessible kernel root itself.

title: Native all-target build should not fail on unrelated POSIX-only tests
body: The queued native build all reached the VIXEN and vixen_lookdev_capture targets but failed four unrelated test objects: ShaderManagement tests include unistd.h, RenderGraph test_shader_source_dir uses unsetenv/setenv, and test_run_data_paths was compiled without /std:c++17. Recovery required separate queued scoped builds of VIXEN and vixen_lookdev_capture. The native target graph should platform-gate or repair those tests, or expose a supported product-target build route for required GPU witnesses.

title: Native checkout should cache its pinned toolchain before build
body: The first queued native build had to run build.bat provision because the lane checkout lacked pinned Ninja/CMake toolchain assets; provisioning downloaded Ninja 1.13.1 and ccache 4.13.6 before configure. The native lane setup should make the declared toolchain available during checkout/prepare so every GPU witness does not pay this provisioning step or depend on a mutable download path.
